description: This file defines a JavaScript class named Session that encapsulates operations for managing session storage in a web environment.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with sessionStorage, including get, set, has, remove, and clear operations.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a JSON object stored under the specified key in sessionStorage.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stringifies and stores a value under the specified key in sessionStorage.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a given key exists in sessionStorage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the item with the specified key from sessionStorage.
